page_title: Levity: Reliable AI Automation for Logistics Operations

sources.entry: levity.ai - Automates data entry, rate lookup, and even drafts email responses—all without leaving your inbox.

summary.name: Levity
summary.one_liner: Levity is an enterprise AI automation platform for logistics operations that analyzes and automates high-volume email workflows such as spot quoting, order entry, and document handling.
use_cases: Automating spot quoting for freight rates
Handling logistics documents and arrival notices
Automating accounts payable and receivable in logistics
Finding repetitive requests and bottlenecks in shared inboxes
summary.what_it_does: Levity describes itself as Communication Intelligence for the global supply chain. It analyzes millions of emails to find repetitive requests, handoffs, and bottlenecks, with an Analytics component for this. Its Flows component turns high-impact workflows into production-grade AI automations. A Governance-style capability provides visibility, human oversight, and continuous feedback for running and improving those automations. The page lists logistics use cases including spot quoting, order entry, track and trace, document handling, arrival notices, accounts receivable, and accounts payable.
notable: Analyzes millions of emails across connected inboxes to surface automation opportunities
Claims ISO 27001 certification and SOC 2 Type II certification, with a Trust Center report
Built for logistics use cases such as spot quoting, order entry, and track and trace
Emphasizes human oversight and feedback loops for AI automations
caveats: Pricing is not stated on the page
Page is mostly marketing with customer testimonials; no specific feature limits or technical details are given
Aimed at enterprise logistics teams rather than individual users
